limitations: delayed feedback cannot predict future drift

mathematical_hypotheses.G0: Under independent bounded fresh observations and current-period representativeness, conditional familywise lifetime error <= alpha_promotion for one controller run across prespecified certification attempts.
mathematical_hypotheses.G1: Under independent trustworthy paired monitoring blocks, false deterioration alarms controlled by allocated alpha_monitor for one controller run.
mathematical_hypotheses.G2: Without representative feedback, no algorithm can uniformly distinguish a changed environment from an unchanged one using identical observations.

predeclared_success_criteria.comparison: Compare against periodic recertification and memoryless learner, not merely fixed reuse.
predeclared_success_criteria.monitor_capability: At least one alarm in deliberately inverted-drift worlds; zero false alarms in stationary worlds desirable.
predeclared_success_criteria.no_promise: No controller required to dominate all baselines or guarantee zero deployment harm; publish negative findings.
predeclared_success_criteria.release_integrity: Full historical and new test suite pass, reproducibility receipt verified, and falsifying feedback regime preserved.

primary_endpoint: mean net task-paired surplus per epoch; paired differences relative to all strong baselines
safety_endpoints: false certifications in source-period fresh validation
